comparison_limits: Iteration1 adds failed and recovering learner states. Its validation action MAE measures a different distribution from tracked0 and cannot establish regression by direct subtraction.
Phase head differs from generic ACT head in architecture, loss, phase supervision and clamping normalized inputs to +/-10; this comparison does not isolate phase alone.
No-ACT head masks both prior and decoder features. Logged zero feature tensors are inactive and are not counted as feature extrapolation.
Visibility denotes detection at the latest 5-tick RGB refresh; ages remain causal since each last accepted detection.
RGB fits the ball to a declared table support plane and remembers unobserved targets. This is not full3D carried-ball or verified-grasp tracking.
The teacher fix which recognizes an unmoved ball after empty pickup was added after tracked1 collection. These heads cannot learn corrective labels which that collection never supplied.
Tracked0 auxiliary phase labels use post-step teacher phase at boundaries; tracked1 labels the actual issued command. Both immutable cohorts were included in the phase fit.
Repeated expert replans are collection diagnostics, not successful recoveries. Collection mixtures use the teacher at beta=.5 and must not be reported as learned-only success.
source_set_contract: Each exact source map is shared_runtime_source_sha256 merged with source_sets[source_set_id]; source_set_id is SHA256 of sorted-key JSON of that full map.
findings: The phase head completed 1/2 development tasks on each arm (SO101 seed12001 in 272 ticks; Panda seed12001 in 205 ticks), with no geometric teacher actions. This is the first successful learned-only Panda pilot, but 2 trials per arm cannot establish 60% reliability.

Generic ACT-conditioned recovery completed 0/2 per arm. Both Panda trials aborted after 320 ticks because their actual TCP poses could not be represented by virtual SO101 within 3mm (14.603mm and 7.636mm residuals). This abort arises while generating frozen-ACT robot input, before a new head action is available.
No-ACT recovery completed 0/2 per arm and never held the ball in any of those four trials. This differs from tracked0 SO101 1/2; the small development comparison is not a broad reliability claim.

Completed ACT/phase decoder features stay below 10 training standard deviations. Their observed extrapolation is concentrated in observable-history channels, especially long jaw-command dwell and unseen bowl ages; the full saved inputs now make this measurable.

Phase SO101 seed12000 predicts LIFT for 434 ticks but never holds/lifts the ball. The head still confuses intended expert progression with verified physical pickup. The later empty-pickup teacher replan fix was not in this training collection.
Tracked1 collection completed 4/8 SO101 and 2/8 Panda mixture tasks, with 52 and 128 expert replans. Teacher execution was approximately half the ticks; these are not learned-only success rates.
